mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_HOTBILL_BILLING_INFO ( CONTRACT_NUMBER, HOTBILL_DATE, SEQ_NO, CHARGE_CODE, AMOUNT, SETTLEMENT_YN, CREATE_DATETIME, UPDATE_DATETIME ) VALUES ( #{contractNumber}, #{hotbillDate}, #{seqNo}, #{chargeCode}, #{amount}, #{settlementYn}, #{createDatetime}, #{updateDatetime} )
mapper.select: SELECT CONTRACT_NUMBER, HOTBILL_DATE, SEQ_NO, CHARGE_CODE, AMOUNT, SETTLEMENT_YN, CREATE_DATETIME, UPDATE_DATETIME FROM TB_HOTBILL_BILLING_INFO WHERE CONTRACT_NUMBER = #{contractNumber} AND HOTBILL_DATE = #{hotbillDate} ORDER BY SEQ_NO
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_BILLING_INFO ( CONTRACT_NUMBER, BILLING_MONTH, SEQ_NO, CHARGE_CODE, AMOUNT, HOTBILL_YN, CREATE_DATETIME ) VALUES ( #{contractNumber}, #{billingMonth}, #{seqNo}, #{chargeCode}, #{amount}, #{hotbillYn}, #{createDatetime} )
mapper.select: SELECT CONTRACT_NUMBER, BILLING_MONTH, SEQ_NO, CHARGE_CODE, AMOUNT, HOTBILL_YN, CREATE_DATETIME FROM TB_BILLING_INFO WHERE CONTRACT_NUMBER = #{contractNumber} AND BILLING_MONTH = #{billingMonth} ORDER BY SEQ_NO
